description: Returns the state business records filed under the name of each company or fund a loan's prospectus names as guarantor or sponsor (entity number, status, formation, registered agent, addresses, officers or managers where the state publishes them, each with its source) and the people tied to it, with whether a business email, mobile number or LinkedIn is on file. A record matches on the same name, word for word: it does not prove it is the company the filing means. Use reveal_contact for one person's contact details. Without a key it returns a notice that a key is needed.

slug.description: The loan slug: the last part of its cmbs.news URL, from search_loans

name: get_loan_companies

outputSchema.description: Every field with its unit and codes, in full: https://cmbs.news/openapi.json (operation getLoanCompanies). Money in US dollars; a rate, occupancy or share is a fraction of 1 (0.0475 is 4.75%) unless it says percent; DSCR is a multiple; dates YYYY-MM-DD.

argumentNote.description: Sent when an argument was renamed, read in another form or left out because it could not be used: says which and how.

asOf.description: Date of the cmbs.news loan data this answer was built from, YYYY-MM-DD (the loan record's as-of date), not the date of the prospectus.

basis.description: Fixed sentence on how state records are matched (same name word for word, ignoring case, punctuation and legal-form spelling) and that a match does not prove it is the company the filing means.

callsLeft.description: Without a key: calls left today on the free allowance, this one counted. Not sent with a Pro or Team key.

candidates.description: On a found: false answer: the closest real records, most likely first; empty when nothing is close.

items.description: One real record close to what was asked.

class.description: A certificate class: its class as the trust files it, e.g.

leftTheTrusts.description: A loan: true when it paid off or left the trusts, so its page shows its last figures.

slug.description: A loan: its slug, to pass to get_loan.

trust.description: A certificate class: the slug of its trust.

trustName.description: A certificate class: the name of its trust.

companies.description: One entry per company or fund the loan's prospectus names as guarantor or sponsor that has a state record or a person on file.

id.description: 16-character hexadecimal id of the company name (the same value as nameId in the other-loans answer).

name.description: The company's name as the prospectuses print it (the most common spelling).

onThisLoan.description: How this loan's prospectuses print the company: one entry per distinct trust, role and printed text.

people.description: People tied to the company: officers a state register lists, individuals the prospectus prints beside the company on the same loan, and decision makers at the company's operating business.

sameNameInSeveralStates.description: Present only when records from more than one state are shown: a fixed sentence warning that they may or may not be the same company.

stateRecords.description: State business-register records filed under exactly this name, best match first.

contactAllowance.description: The account's monthly allowance for opening contacts, shared by everyone on the account.

delaware.description: Fixed sentence: Delaware publishes no officers, managers or members and is not read.

found.description: Present only when the loan asked for is not on file: false.

keyNote.description: Sent when the key given was a placeholder (such as YOUR_KEY): the call was answered as a call without a key, and this says why.

limits.description: Link to the page describing limits and plans.

matchNote.description: Present when the text sent was not an exact identifier but fit exactly one record: how it was read, so the caller can check it is the record meant.

message.description: Plain sentence saying what is not included in this plan and where limits and plans are described.

nextCall.description: On a found: false answer: the exact call to make next, as {tool, arguments}. An argument written in <angle brackets> is a template to fill in.

note.description: Present only when companies is empty: no company or fund this loan's prospectus names has a state record or a contact on file.

plan.description: The caller's plan; always "free" in this answer.

proRequired.description: Always true in this answer: the data needs a paid plan (Pro or Team).

reportWrongContact.description: Link to report a wrong contact or record on this loan's page.

revealContact.description: How to open one person's contact details: the method and URL template, with {personId} to be replaced by a people[].id.

slug.description: The loan's identifier on cmbs.news (last part of its page URL).

source.description: Fixed attribution line: SEC EDGAR Form ABS-EE and Form 10-D filings, read by cmbs.news; servicer-reported, unaudited; link to the terms.

statesRead.description: Fixed sentence listing the state registers that are read (New York, Connecticut, Colorado, Oregon, Texas Comptroller) and those that are not (Delaware, Florida, California).

url.description: Link to the loan's page on cmbs.news.

use.description: Fixed sentence on permitted use: business contacts for business use, TCPA and Do Not Call duties on the caller, not a consumer report, no bulk copying or resale.

title: Companies behind a loan
